faqs.question: How do I know if I have a clothes moth infestation in my Elizabeth home?
faqs.answer: Signs of clothes moth infestation include small holes in wool, silk, or cashmere garments, webbing in closet corners, silken tubes or cases on fabrics, and seeing small beige or gold-colored moths flying near wardrobes. You may also notice larvae (small white caterpillars) on clothing or carpet edges. Our Elizabeth technicians provide free phone assessments to confirm the extent of any infestation.
